# pejorative

> Disparaging, derogatory, belittling (adj); a name or word that is disparaging (noun)


## Example

- *refers to a term). Most psychologists object to the pejorative term "shrink", believing that they expand the human mind, not limit it. This word has other definitions but this is the most important one for the GRE.*
